_comment: SerpentX 'sovereign' preset: decentralize with your OWN node. Pool A = OCEAN via a local DATUM Gateway (TIDES payouts, your node builds the block templates, non-custodial). Pool B = your self-hosted solo pool (public-pool) for the lottery leg. Both are local Stratum V1 endpoints, so SerpentX talks to them with zero extra config. See docs/STRATEGIES.md. Replace the addresses/hosts with yours.

pools._note: Local DATUM Gateway (OCEAN/TIDES). Default DATUM stratum port 23334.
Self-hosted public-pool solo instance on your LAN (lottery leg).
